title: Answer: consciousness is awareness of nearby counterfactual worlds

statements.text: To be conscious of an object is to be aware of counterfactual worlds in which its degrees of freedom are perturbed while everything else is held fixed. The awareness arises from an interplay of memory with quantum processes in the ion channels of neurons, which the brain uses for energy efficiency. Palmer offers this as speculative.

sources.quote: the notion of consciousness is defined in terms of an awareness of what are perceived to be nearby counterfactual worlds in state space
This section is necessarily very speculative in nature.
